question: Which host and telemetry-event limits does Datadog set for an accepted open source project, and which products does the account include? The programme page publishes no figure, and one recipient reports logs, metrics, APM and traces.
why: The page says only that hosts and telemetry events 'may be limited'. Amounts, if any, show to an accepted applicant, and an application is not a research step (AGENTS.md section 2 rule 13), so the free_tier of dev-services/datadog-open-source states no amount.
